title: Northgate Optical Adaptation Guarantee: Crediting the Switch-Down Price Gap
content:
Under the Northgate Optical adaptation guarantee, the part of the switch-down price gap credited to the member when a non-adapt remake moves a job to a lower-priced lens design depends on when the latest non-adapt remake was opened and whether it was the job's first remake.

**Days counted.** The days a switch-down remake is counted at are the calendar days from the dispensed date of the job to the opening date of the latest non-adapt remake, the dispensed date being day 0. The opening date of a non-adapt remake is the date of its remake charge entry carrying the non-adapt reason; the latest one is the entry with the latest date, and its remake number shows whether it was the job's first remake (remake number 1).

**The window.** The window is the non-adapt window of the lens design now on the job — the design the job was switched to:

| Lens design now on the job | Non-adapt window |
|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 0 days |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 30 days |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 30 days |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 60 days |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 90 days |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 90 days |

**Clause.** Where that non-adapt remake was the job's first remake and was opened no later than the non-adapt window of the lens design now on the job, the whole switch-down price gap is credited. Where that non-adapt remake was opened no later than that window, the window being at least one day long, but was not the job's first remake, the switch-down price gap is credited in proportion to the unexpired part of the window: the gap is multiplied by the window's days not yet used when the remake was opened and divided by the window's length in days. A remake opened after the window falls under neither of these two terms.

## Cases (hypothetical jobs, switched to Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses, window 90 days, gap 60.00)

| Latest non-adapt remake | Opened on | Term | Part of the gap credited |
|---|---|---|---|
| remake number 1 | day 40 | first remake within the window | 60.00 (the whole gap) |
| remake number 1 | day 90 | first remake within the window (last day) | 60.00 |
| remake number 2 | day 60 | within the window, not the first remake | 60.00 multiplied by 30 and divided by 90, that is 20.00 |
| remake number 2 | day 90 | within the window, not the first remake | 60.00 multiplied by 0 and divided by 90, that is 0.00 |
| remake number 1 | day 91 | after the window | neither term |

A job now carrying Northgate Single Vision Lenses has a window of 0 days: only a first remake opened on the dispensed date itself (day 0) falls within it, and the proportional term never applies because the window is not at least one day long.
